items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I've seen Ahmad Jamal and Art Tatum, they'd just get up and walk off the stand

ctx.x: Yes, you can't just be silent.

No, but as I've said, I've seen Ahmad Jamal and Art Tatum, they'd just get up and walk off the stand, because people are talking. I've seen other people do that too. I didn't have a problem unless they were loud and rowdy person.
Well then you know, there was the, after bop had become popular, there was the business where they ignored the audience totally.
